market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: Despite Trump's repeated statements about acquiring Greenland, both Denmark and Greenland have firmly rejected the idea. Transfer of sovereignty or exclusive jurisdiction over any territory would require complex negotiations and is extremely unlikely to conclude within two years. The existing US military presence does not meet the resolution's requirement of primary legal control. Given the political and procedural hurdles, true probability is far lower than markets imply.
evidence_points: Greenlandic and Danish government repeatedly said the island is not for sale
Trump's prior offer in 2019 was rebuffed, and current rhetoric has not advanced to formal negotiations
Short timeframe until end of 2026 for any binding agreement, which would need legislative approval in multiple parliaments
sources_consulted: Contemporaneous news reports on Trump's comments
